title: Singular graded limits and metric growth under Hermitian–Yang–Mills flow
label: Stability and Geometric Degeneration

related.label: Nonsimplicial local stability chambers of toric tangent bundles
Hermitian–Yang–Mills flow at and beyond a stability wall

abstract_html: We prove that two bounded-remainder extensions of weight-filtration asymptotics for Hermitian–Yang–Mills flow fail for rank-two bundles on connected compact Kähler surfaces with a saturated equal-slope line subsheaf and a singular torsion-free quotient. For every smooth initial metric with fixed Hermitian–Einstein determinant, the squared L2 norm of the inclusion is o(T−12) as flow time T tends to infinity. The pointwise squared norm divided by this integral converges to a positive constant away from the finite singular set. In the quotient by sheaves supported at points, the full rank-polarized subobject lattice has weights −12,+12 and no subsequent iterated weights. Neither relative metric comparability nor a bounded ordinary matrix-logarithm remainder realizes this model on any nonempty compact subset away from the singularities. A splitting-independent Bochner–Martinelli residue, global normalization and an exact dissipation identity give the obstruction, including for nonreduced singularities and repeated line factors. A projective K3 example realizes both features. For a toric tangent-bundle example, we also identify the stable-side Hermitian–Einstein limit and its multiplicity-one curvature concentration.
